entrypoints.summary: The workflow accepts pull_request events and renders github.head_ref in the Get pull_request data shell run block.
The workflow accepts workflow_run completion events for pull-request-triggered workflows and renders github.event.workflow_run.head_branch in the same shell run block.

affected_components.role: The pre-fix step constructs shell source containing direct GitHub expressions for branch metadata.

causal_paths.kind: GitHub Actions expression interpolation to runner-shell evaluation

preconditions: An attacker can supply a pull-request branch name or reach the workflow_run path rooted in configured pull-request-triggered workflows.
The affected pre-fix workflow revision is in use.
The get-pr-data job executes with its configured write-all permission scope.

trigger_steps.summary: Cause the pull_request or configured workflow_run event path to execute the Get pull_request data step.

impact.affected_asset: The vets-api repository's GitHub Actions job authority, including its write-all permission scope and job token context.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause attacker-controlled branch metadata to be interpreted as shell syntax in the workflow run script.
impact.security_effect: Potential unauthorized code execution in the privileged GitHub Actions job.

causal_trace.summary: An external pull-request contributor controls the branch-name values exposed as github.head_ref and, through the configured workflow_run path, github.event.workflow_run.head_branch.

The pre-fix workflow places those GitHub expressions directly in executable run-script text, including output-writing echo commands and a HEAD_BRANCH shell assignment, rather than carrying the values as shell data.

GitHub Actions expression interpolation renders the branch value into the Get pull_request data shell script before that script is evaluated by the runner shell; crafted branch text can therefore alter shell syntax.

The resulting command-execution capability is in a get-pr-data job configured with write-all permissions and a GITHUB_TOKEN environment value; the disclosure describes the outcome as possible unauthorized high-privilege code execution.

failure.operation: Runner-shell evaluation of the Get pull_request data run script after direct GitHub-expression interpolation of branch metadata

primary_invariant.kind: data/code separation across GitHub Actions expression rendering and shell execution
primary_invariant.statement: Pull-request-derived branch metadata must be passed to the runner shell as data and must not be directly rendered into executable shell source.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-fix run block directly interpolates github.head_ref and github.event.workflow_run.head_branch into shell commands and an assignment.

quality.review_notes: The report and immutable pre/post workflow sources substantiate the interpolation-to-shell mechanism and remediation. No malicious branch-name proof of concept, Actions execution log, or test/run result establishes observed command execution; high-privilege execution remains a potential impact as framed by the disclosure. The fixing commit locator is abbreviated in the supplied material.

remediation.invariant_restored: Branch values are assigned to SAFE_HEAD_REF and SAFE_WORKFLOW_HEAD_BRANCH through the step environment and are consumed as shell variables, separating the branch data from the shell source at the affected uses.
mitigation_classes: removal of direct branch-expression interpolation from run blocks
